report.verdict: Your hospital nursing work includes adult care, weekend charge duties and precepting. I'd hesitate on this application because I can't tell what your patient assignments look like or whether your RN license meets North Carolina's requirement.
write_up: You bring hospital nursing experience from Riverside Methodist and Mount Carmel East, including adult care and patients before and after surgery. This resume has a common problem: it lists nursing duties without much about the patients or assignments behind them. That makes it less likely to stand out for the medical-surgical role.

The Epic line is a good model because it names both the documentation and the system you used. Your RN, BLS and ACLS are easy to find, too. For this posting, a recruiter will still look for your license state and status, along with the kind of patient assignment you manage.

Let's start with your first Riverside line: add your unit type and patient assignment if you can substantiate them. Then give the charge and precepting work the same treatment, so those responsibilities don't get lost among the routine duties.

cards.line: Provide direct patient care for adult patients across 12-hour shifts
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can't tell what unit you work on or how many patients are in your assignment. Both matter for this medical-surgical opening.
cards.example: Provide direct patient care for adult patients on [unit type], caring for [number] patients across 12-hour shifts
cards.question: What kind of unit do you work on, and how many patients are typically in your assignment?

cards.line: Administer medications and monitor patient response
cards.cannot_tell: Medication administration is part of the job, but this doesn't show what you administer or what responses you monitor.
cards.example: Administer [medication types] and monitor patient response for [responses monitored]
cards.question: What medications do you commonly administer, and what patient responses do you monitor?

cards.line: Educate patients and families on discharge plans
cards.cannot_tell: Discharge education fits the role, but the plans could cover many different needs. Name what you teach.
cards.example: Educate patients and families on discharge plans, including [education topics]
cards.question: What do you commonly teach patients and families before discharge?

cards.line: Serve as charge nurse on weekends
cards.cannot_tell: Charge nurse is a meaningful responsibility. The resume doesn't say what you coordinate or how many people are involved.
cards.example: Serve as charge nurse on weekends, coordinating [responsibilities] for [number] [staff or patients]
cards.question: What do you coordinate as charge nurse, and how many staff or patients are involved?

cards.cannot_tell: Precepting is directly relevant to this job. The line doesn't yet show what you teach or how many nurses you've precepted.
cards.example: Precept [number] new graduate nurses in [skills or tasks]
cards.question: How many new graduate nurses have you precepted, and what did you teach them?

cards.where: Mount Carmel East Registered Nurse, line 1
cards.line: Cared for patients before and after surgery
cards.cannot_tell: This establishes surgical care, but not what that care involved. A detail from before or after surgery would make the work more concrete.
cards.example: Cared for patients before and after surgery, including [care tasks]
cards.question: What care did you provide to patients before and after surgery?

cards.where: Mount Carmel East Registered Nurse, line 2
cards.line: Documented assessments and care plans in Epic
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model: it tells a recruiter exactly what you documented and where you did it. Bring that same level of detail to the Riverside work.
The posting asks for a current unrestricted North Carolina or compact state RN license. Your resume lists RN but doesn't name the state or status.
cards.example: RN, [license state and status], BLS, ACLS
cards.question: What state issued your RN license, and is it current, unrestricted and eligible under the nurse licensure compact?

fit.why: Your current and previous nursing roles show hospital patient care, discharge education and Epic documentation.
fit.level: mid-level, hospital RN roles with charge and precepting duties
fit.note: Your Epic documentation and precepting work are relevant to the unit's responsibilities. The role is in Raleigh and works nights with rotating weekends.
